name: plandose-tests
description: Tests for the PlanDose WordPress plugin (not shipped with the plugin).

scripts.test:wp: node --test --test-concurrency=1 wp-integration/*.test.js; s=$?; php wp-integration/settings-frontend-1242.php "${PD_WP_PATH:-/home/claude/wpenv}/wp-load.php" || s=1; exit $s
scripts.qa:php: cd tools/php-qa && composer install --no-interaction --no-progress -q && vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=2G && vendor/bin/phpcs
